[[File:Quarantine_inspection.jpg|thumb|250px|Droids performing a quarantine inspection at the Tomorrowland Starport]]
A '''quarantine inspector''' was tasked with carefully checking [[Astroculture|astrocultural]] freight for a travel agency's customs.<ref name="Complete Guide to Star Tours">''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]''</ref> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]],<ref name="KOTHB">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> the quarantine inspectors for the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency's [[Tomorrowland Starport]] were two [[PanaRobo]]s, [[P-6]] and [[S-4]]. They worked in the Quarantine Section of the [[Spaceport/Legends|starport's]] Baggage Claim, under the supervision of an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]] [[Quarantine supervisor R2 unit|unit]].<ref name="Complete Guide to Star Tours" />
